PE and Sports Premium Funding
The Primary PE & Sports Premium is a Government grant that must be used to fund improvements to the provision of Physical Education (PE) and sport.
Primary schools must use the funding to make additional and sustainable improvements to the quality of PE and sport they offer. The sport funding can only be spent on sport and PE provision in schools and examples of activities this type of funding covers are:
Run sport competitions
Increase pupils’ participation in the School Games
Run sports activities with other schools.
